label: Control: mosquito, phases randomised
notes: A control for the honest test: same spectrum as the mosquito, no bursts. If a drawing driven by this looks the same as one driven by the fly, the fly does not matter.

channels.steer: left−right wingbeat amplitude (wbad): the fly's steering command, signed — phase-randomised surrogate
channels.effort: left+right wingbeat amplitude (wbas): flight effort; < 0.3 = wings stopped — phase-randomised surrogate
channels.heading: the fly's heading in the simulator, degrees, continuous (trial resets removed); some trials spin at hundreds of degrees per second — phase-randomised surrogate
